set: Fantasy Crux creature style candidate — Cinematic Graphic Novel
imageGenerationMode: built-in image generation; per-creature content blueprint plus style-only Graphic Novel anchor
styleLock: Mature painted graphic novel. Semi-realistic believable anatomy and architecture built from decisive brush-ink drawing; variable-width dark sepia-indigo contours with dry-brush breaks; restrained directional cross-hatching only in core shadows; four-to-six broad matte gouache-like color and value shapes with a few translucent glaze transitions; crisp focal edges with selectively lost or broken shadow edges; angular readable silhouette simplification; materials rendered through designed shape rhythms rather than photographic microtexture. High detail at faces, hands, eyes, creature heads, and key material junctions; medium detail across bodies and main structures; sparse atmospheric backgrounds. Cinematic sequential-art finish, neither superhero comic nor photorealistic concept painting.
colorTreatment: Natural local colors, moderate saturation, warm-light/cool-shadow separation, at most one restrained focal accent family; no forced shared palette or mood.
referencePolicy: content blueprint supplies creature identity, stats and ability interpretation, anatomy, proportions, pose, temperament, and environmental interaction
style anchor supplies rendering language only
bear and dragon reuse the approved Graphic Novel exploration images

interpretations.guardianSpirit: bound to a bronze burial mask

qaPolicy: description, characteristics, and ability emphasis reviewed
anatomy and limb plan visually inspected
pose, action, silhouette, and camera diversity visually inspected
rejected anatomy failures regenerated before acceptance
